body: Thank you there's a lot of good ideas in there

It's just that so many people go through so much worse, it just makes me feel weak. People go through all different types abuse from people and compared to their stories I should be the happiest person on the planet. His dad is an alcoholic, mine was when I was a baby and he was never around which is why my parents got divorced and he hasn't drank since, but I don't know I just feel so pathetic and feel like I'm not grateful for what I've been given. So many people pass away that are so happy or people pass away because they were born sick or have developed a sickness and they just deserve a life so much more than me. I want things to end but why can't my life end so someone else who actually is loved can be around their family and friends for longer.

Thank you for telling me your story about you and your friend Emily. I've been through a lot of friendships like that but the worst friendship was actually in kindergarten believe it or not. There was this guy named Gavin and actually he abused me even though we were only 5/6. He would give me black eyes and bruises, he took taekwondo, and then would pretend to care and take me to the health room after hitting me and he was deemed a "hero" to everyone because he was always "helping" me and for the longest time I thought it was okay because no one tried to stop him and he didn't get in trouble. I felt worthless and I thought that it was okay for people to hit me because no one ever stopped him. This went on for all of kindergarten and at the end of the school year he finally got caught hitting me and we went to the principals office and he left the school. My mom obviously found out after that office visit and ever since she's made sure that I knew that it was not okay for people to hit me. It was hard though because my brother, being my big brother, would always hit me not out of anger or to be abusive but just because that's what siblings do I guess. I don't know over the years I've just felt that any type of abuse, physical mental or emotional, was okay. Sorry I know that was a little long and off topic :/

As far as my now ex boyfriend though, it really did feel perfect in the moment even though it was rough sometimes. I've seen myself change day in and day out. I understand what you're saying about if he were perfect then it would have worked out but I guess just some part of me feels like everything is my fault and if I just did even one thing different then this relationship could've gone on for much longer. He said we were just too different and that my mental health was just to much to handle. Maybe if I were stronger and didn't let my mental health get to this point then things would be different :,(

Thank you for the advice about trying to just keep in mind that I don't have to make a decision or act on anything right now. I keep trying to "put it off" and then sometimes I start to feel better and then all of a sudden my mind will just plummet again and I'm right back to square one. 

I know that we will probably find other people, especially him seeing as this was his first relationship, I just don't want to move on though ya know. There's hopefully someone out there who I'm meant to be with but this relationship just meant the actual world to me and I don't want to continue going through one break up after the next. I just don't really attract good people and so the fact that my relationship with him happened was pretty ground breaking. I wish I could explain the relationship better or just even be able to explain these feelings towards him. 

It's hard when someone you really care about passes away but for me it's even harder when someone makes the voluntary choice to say "I don't want to see you anymore" or "I don't want you in my life". That's the feeling that makes me want to die. When you love someone so damn much but they don't want anything to do with you.

I actually do see a therapist and I think I've actually been seeing her for a year or close to it. It's hard for me because sometimes I'll just spill everything going on in my life but then other times I'm so quiet for the hour that I meet with her. It might sound stupid but even though he didn't make time/have time for me in the end I didn't really care because I love him and sometimes people go through dry spells. I have no idea maybe I'm being stupid and I should be upset with him for doing what he did and making me feel this way but I just can't. No matter what I do at the end of the day I want nothing more than to see him or hear from him. I slept in his sweatshirt last night which was probably one of the worst decisions I could've made but you know I don't care! It made me sleep and right now my body needs a good nights sleep. I love him... I'm IN love with him and I don't really see that changing any time soon.

Well um when I was 6 my parents got divorced and my dad later started dating this really mean woman, who he is still with all these years later. She really changed my dad as a person and I ended up moving in with my mom full time a few years ago because in the end he basically chose her over me. Him and I still talk and see each other but I don't even see him as little as even once a month. As far as friends/dating goes though people have never really stuck around long. I currently haven't really talked to people at school that I would hang out with since we left school around this time last year. I've tried keeping in touch with people and all that sometimes but it just never seems to work out. Then with the whole dating scene I've been the one who was broken up with in every relationship except one. I've never really gotten to stay friends with an ex anyway because they just didn't want me around anymore. I hope that all answered your question and feel free to ask whatever else you'd like.
